card.name: Small words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small words like "as", "at", "once" or "every" that come right after "given", "not" or "and" in dose-administration directions. They introduce how or how often a dose is given.

modes.label: Not as a mixed injection
modes.description: The word "as" after "not" in the instruction to give two injectable drugs separately.
modes.example: they must be administered separately and not<< as>> a mixed injection.

modes.label: Given at a schedule
modes.description: A linking word after "given" or "and" that introduces frequency or interval.
modes.example: The recommended dose is 162 mg given<< once>> every week as a subcutaneous injection

modes.label: Taken at intervals
modes.description: The word "at" after "exactly as directed and" in contraceptive dosing text.
modes.example: must be taken exactly as directed and<< at>> intervals not exceeding 24 hours.
